lcd-display.purpose: Elapsed time on the track page player, in fixed-width digit cells over ghost 8s.

lcd-display-sm-up.purpose: The same readout from the 640px breakpoint.

wordmark.purpose: "Feedback" in lcd-ink at the left of the app header.

lcd-figure.purpose: Tabular figures at 1rem: track lengths (ink) on home and project rows, the project page's track numbers (muted), the version number ("V3", ink) in each version row, a version's length (ink) in its column, inline in the meta line on phones, and the upload percent (lcd-ink).

lcd-figure-sm.purpose: Tabular figures at 0.875rem: the project's total length in the Tracks count line.

lcd-label.purpose: Mini-player time line; version and state word on the track player; status segment and badge words (uppercase).

headline.purpose: Page H1: "Your tracks", "Projects", the project title, the track title, "Edit project", the pending and rejected notices; the signed-out pitch at 24ch.

section-title.purpose: H2s such as "Upload a track", "Tracks", "Your projects", "Versions", and "Upload a new version"; in a project's Edit mode the "Cover art" and "Delete project" H2s drop to 1rem.

title.purpose: Track title link in the mini-player.

body.purpose: Page text, field text, change notes (ink, line breaks kept), confirmation sentences; descriptions in muted at 65ch, the pending and rejected notices at 60ch. Small text carries labels, meta lines, status lines, and errors; "Current" leads the current version's meta line in ink at 500, in the sans.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav items, and button text.

shadows.name: shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: Raised graphite housing: player panel and mini-player.

shadows.name: shadow-lcd
shadows.purpose: Recessed LCD well on every LCD window (readout, waveform, status meter, status badge, upload progress bar); the lcd utility adds a 2px chrome-lo lip and a 3px chrome-lip ring.

shadows.name: shadow-focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Paired with the 2px accent outline at 2px offset on buttons, links, nav items, the wordmark, the file picker, whole list rows, and player controls; also the primary button hover.

shadows.name: nav-underline
shadows.purpose: The current nav item's 2px accent underline (a line, not depth).

motion.name: progress-stripes-drift
motion.purpose: The upload bar's lit stripes, only while an upload or processing start is in progress; animation none under prefers-reduced-motion. The one ambient motion; not a general license to animate.

components.name: Transport Button (large)

components.name: Waveform Window

components.css: .ds-wave { position: relative; height: 96px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background-color: var(--color-lcd); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 1px, var(--color-lcd-cell) 1px 4px); border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome-edge); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lcd), 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome-lo), 0 0 0 3px var(--color-chrome-lip); } .ds-wave::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0 4px, var(--color-lcd) 4px 6px), repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-lcd) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px); } .ds-wave-played { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 25%; bottom: 25%; width: 34%; background: var(--color-lcd-ink); } .ds-wave-head { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: calc(34% - 1px); width: 2px; z-index: 1; background: var(--color-lcd-cyan); } .ds-wave:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

components.name: Button

components.name: Danger Button

components.name: Ghost Icon Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Move Night drive up"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 6l8 8-2.5 2.5L12 11l-5.5 5.5L4 14z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border: 1px solid var(--color-field-edge); border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; width: 2.5rem; padding: 0; color: var(--color-muted); background: transparent; border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border-color: var(--color-field-edge); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

components.name: Select Field

components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-selrow { display: flex; gap: 8px; max-width: 28rem; } .ds-select { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-select span { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 2.5rem 0.5rem 0.75rem; appearance: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border: 1px solid var(--color-field-edge); border-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-selbtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border: 1px solid var(--color-field-edge); border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-selbtn:hover { color: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-selbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

components.name: App Header
components.description: Wordmark, main nav with an accent underline on the current item, account link. Pending and rejected accounts see only the wordmark and Sign out.

Feedback
TracksProjects
Sign out
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 16px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-canvas); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--color-lcd-ink); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; } .ds-header nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; } .ds-header nav a:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-header nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--color-accent); } .ds-signout { margin-left: auto; align-self: center; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--color-field-edge); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-signout:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

components.name: Status Meter
components.description: Project stage as an LCD segment radio group: passed lit, current solid, later unlit but readable.
components.html: Status
components.css: .ds-meter { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-meter legend { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-meter-well { background: var(--color-lcd); border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome-edge); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lcd), 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome-lo), 0 0 0 3px var(--color-chrome-lip); display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; margin: 3px; padding: 4px; } .ds-seg { position: relative; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-lcd-unlit); } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-seg.ds-passed { color: var(--color-lcd-ink); } .ds-seg:not(.ds-current):hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-seg.ds-current { background: var(--color-lcd-ink); color: var(--color-lcd); } .ds-seg:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The stage at list size: fixed-width LCD chip with pips and the stage word.
components.html: Demo
components.css: .ds-badge { background: var(--color-lcd); border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome-edge); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lcd), 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome-lo), 0 0 0 3px var(--color-chrome-lip); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 7.5rem; margin: 3px; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-pips { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-pips i { width: 6px; height: 10px; background: var(--color-lcd-cell); } .ds-pips i.on { background: var(--color-lcd-ink); } .ds-badge-word { font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-lcd-ink); }

components.name: Project Cover
components.description: Cover art squares: 48px leading a projects-list row, 96px (128px from sm) on the project page; shown bare with a 1px rule edge on a chrome-lo backing. Shown here empty: the chrome-lo placeholder with a field-edge note.
components.css: .ds-covers { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; } .ds-cover { flex-shrink: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--color-chrome-lo); object-fit: cover; } .ds-cover-page { width: 96px; height: 96px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-cover-page { width: 128px; height: 128px; } } .ds-cover-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--color-field-edge); }

components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 2.5rem 1fr 4rem auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row.ds-dragging { position: relative; z-index: 1; background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border-radius: 0.25rem; outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); } .ds-grip { display: flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--color-field-edge); cursor: grab; } .ds-dragging .ds-grip { color: var(--color-accent); cursor: grabbing; } .ds-num { font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-main { min-width: 0; } .ds-main a { font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-main a:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-main p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-len { text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-acts { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-ghost { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0; color: var(--color-muted); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border-color: var(--color-field-edge); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

components.name: Upload Progress
components.description: Progressbar in an LCD window: lit drifting lime stripes over still unlit stripes, percent in Silkscreen. Used on home, for a new version on the track page, and (capped at 20rem) for cover art.

components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 3px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-lcd); border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome-edge); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lcd), 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome-lo), 0 0 0 3px var(--color-chrome-lip); } .ds-progress-track { flex: 1; height: 12px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--color-lcd-ghost) 0 6px, var(--color-lcd-cell) 6px 12px); background-size: 16.97px 16.97px; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--color-lcd-ink) 0 6px, var(--color-lcd-dim) 6px 12px); background-size: 16.97px 16.97px; animation: ds-stripes 0.8s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-stripes { to { background-position: 16.97px 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress-fill { animation: none; } } .ds-progress-pct { width: 3rem; text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-lcd-ink); }

components.css: .ds-vlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-vrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr; column-gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); } .ds-vnum { padding-top: 2px; font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-vbody { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; } .ds-vmain { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-vnotes { margin: 0; white-space: pre-line; overflow-wrap: break-word; } .ds-vnone { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-vmeta, .ds-vreason { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-vcur { font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-vlen { font-family: var(--font-lcd); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-vfail, .ds-vreason { color: var(--color-danger); } .ds-vedit { flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-muted); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-vedit:hover { background: var(--color-chrome-lo); border-color: var(--color-field-edge); } .ds-vedit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus-glow); }

narrative.overview:
Feedback borrows the late-90s desktop music player: a graphite hardware housing, a recessed LCD window with lime phosphor ink, and chunky bevel buttons that sink when pressed. The waveform sits inside the LCD as segmented bars. The part you've already heard is lit, the rest shows as dim lime, and the empty cells stay faintly visible behind both, like the unlit segments on a real LCD.

**Scope so far: the player, the app header, home, the project pages, and the track page.** The player means the track page's waveform player and the global mini-player. The app header sits on every page. Home (`/`, in all four states: signed out, pending, rejected, and signed in with the upload form and your tracks), the projects list (`/projects`), the project page (`/projects/[projectId]`, with its cover art), and the track page around its player (`/tracks/[trackId]`: the header block, the Project selector, the version history with its notes editor, and the new-version upload) are the working screens: the player's world extended to forms and lists, with flat graphite controls, 1px rules between rows, and the LCD well kept for things that read out (the status meter, the status badge, and the upload progress bar). A project's cover art is the one image in the system, and it sits bare, without chrome or an LCD well. Every page uses the same 48rem column under the header, but the bodies of sign-in and sign-up are still deliberately plain semantic HTML. The direction for everything not built yet (glossy LimeWire toolbars, results tables, window panels, Aqua surfaces, light mode, skins) is in CLAUDE.md section 9, "Visual style: Y2K / Winamp / LimeWire". It is not recorded here because none of it exists in code. When one of those surfaces gets built, add it to this file from the shipped code.

The system is quiet and practical: dark only, no decorative motion, and one bright signature per screen (the lit LCD of the player, the status meter on a project, or the upload bar on home while a file goes up). All tokens live in `app/globals.css` under `@theme`, and components use them, never one-off hex values.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite chrome housing on the player, raised by a 1px top highlight and a soft drop.
Recessed deep green-black LCD windows set into their surroundings with a dark lip and a faint outer highlight.
Lit, dim, and unlit segments: the LCD always shows its unlit state.
Working screens are flat: solid graphite controls with a 1px edge, lists on 1px rules, no cards and no gradients behind text.
Lime for content inside the LCD, a slightly different lime for interaction, cyan for secondary player readouts and the playhead.
Bitmap face for readouts, figures, and the wordmark; clean system sans for everything else.
Cover art sits bare: a square with small corners and a 1px hairline, never housed in chrome or an LCD well.
Still by default: the only motion is a dragged row following the pointer and the upload bar's stripes drifting while an upload is in progress (still under reduced motion).

rules.name: The Lit and Unlit Rule
rules.body: The LCD always shows its unlit state: played audio is `lcd-ink`, audio still to play is `lcd-dim`, empty cells are `lcd-cell`, and every digit sits over a ghost "8" in `lcd-ghost`. Status stages work the same way: passed stages lit in `lcd-ink`, the current one solid `lcd-ink`, later ones in `lcd-unlit` (words must stay readable, so they don't drop to `lcd-cell`); the badge's pips are lit or `lcd-cell`. The upload bar too: its done part is lit stripes (`lcd-ink` and `lcd-dim`), and the rest of the track shows the same stripes held still in `lcd-ghost` and `lcd-cell`. Never draw LCD content on a blank window.

rules.name: The Two Limes Rule
rules.body: `lcd-ink` is what displays (LCD content and the wordmark); `accent` is what responds to you (focus, hover, the current nav item, the dragged row, selection, and the primary button's fill). Don't swap them.

rules.name: The Cyan Channel Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears only in LCD contexts: the playhead and secondary readouts. It is never a button, link, or body color.

rules.name: The Bitmap for Readouts Rule
rules.body: Silkscreen is for readouts and figures: times, lengths, totals, track numbers, percents, version numbers, state and stage words, and the wordmark. Titles, labels, buttons, errors, forms, comments, and body text use the sans. In sentence-like lines (subtitles, the version meta line, status lines) only the length switches to Silkscreen; "Current", status words, dates, and an inline "v4" stay sans.

rules.name: The Housed Hardware Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe hardware: raised housing, recessed LCD windows, buttons that sink. Beyond those, only the focus glow and the nav underline use a shadow. Working-screen controls, rows, and sections get none.

rules.name: The Bare Art Rule
rules.body: Cover art is the artist's own image and brings its own colour, so it sits bare: square, 0.25rem corners, a 1px `rule` edge, and a `chrome-lo` backing that only shows while it loads or when there's no cover. No panel chrome, LCD well, bevel, shadow, or gradient around it, and nothing drawn over it.

dos: **Do** build new styled surfaces from the tokens and utilities in `app/globals.css`, never one-off hex values.
**Do** keep the LCD's unlit state visible: ghost "8"s behind digits, `lcd-cell` behind the waveform, `lcd-unlit` for stages ahead.
**Do** use `accent` for focus on every themed control: a 2px outline at 2px offset plus the glow on buttons and links, at no offset with an accent edge on fields.

**Do** keep everything still: no marquees, visualizers, or animated effects. The only motion is a dragged row following the pointer and the upload bar's stripes drifting while an upload or processing start is in progress; both stay still at rest, and the stripes stop under reduced motion. Neither is a license to animate anything else.
**Do** put text on a solid backing (`canvas`, `chrome-lo`, or `lcd`), never on a gradient (CLAUDE.md section 9).
**Do** keep working-screen controls flat graphite with a 1px `field-edge` edge, and save the LCD well for things that read out.
**Do** separate list rows with 1px `rule` lines, and when the title is the row's link, put keyboard focus around the whole row.
**Do** keep privacy and destructive UI plain: literal wording, `danger` only for destructive actions, and a confirmation that says what stays and that it can't be undone.
**Do** check CLAUDE.md section 9 for the direction of any surface not recorded here, and record it here once it ships.
donts: **Don't** set titles, labels, buttons, errors, or body text in Silkscreen.
**Don't** use `lcd-cyan` or `lcd-ink` for buttons or links; interaction color is `accent`.
**Don't** put a gradient, bevel, or shadow on working-screen controls, rows, or sections; those belong to player hardware and LCD windows.
**Don't** wrap list items in cards; use rows on rules.
**Don't** house cover art in chrome, an LCD well, a bevel, a shadow, or a gradient, or draw over it; it sits bare with a 1px `rule` edge.
**Don't** style the sign-in and sign-up bodies until the owner asks; they stay plain semantic HTML.
**Don't** copy Winamp, LimeWire, Microsoft, or Apple names, logos, skins, or assets.
